adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb the diff adds `require 'open-uri'` and then calls `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)`; using `Kernel#open` on a string is dangerous because a value starting with `|` will execute a shell command and return an IO. Since `feed_polling_url` is an admin-controlled SiteSetting, this makes that setting a code-execution vector on the Sidekiq worker. The same pattern exists in TopicEmbed.import_remote (`open(url).read`), which is invoked from lib/tasks/disqus.thor via `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], ...)`.
